title: Retention Time Prediction by Direct System Mapping
text: rePredRet predicts retention times (RTs) directly mapping chromatographic systems using monotonically constrained Generalized Additive Models (GAMs). Key assumptions: - Elution order largely conserved similar chromatographic systems - Compounds elute early one system tend elute early similar systems algorithm: 1. Find compounds measured source target systems 2. Fit monotonically constrained GAM RT pairs 3. Use bootstrap resampling (1000 iterations) estimate confidence intervals 4. Predictions filtered CI width calibration data density
